title: Notice on Position Mode Upgrade for Binance COIN-M Futures (2026-06-15)
text: This is a general Binance Exchange Notice. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, The  position mode   setting in   Binance COIN-M Futures is undergoing an upgrade from  2026-06-15 03:00 (UTC) . The upgrade will sync up the position mode setting in both USDⓈ-M and COIN-M Futures. If users have different position mode settings in USDⓈ-M and COIN-M Futures, the position mode setting in COIN-M Futures will be adjusted to align with the setting in USDⓈ-M Futures. For example, a user has set “Hedge Mode” in USDⓈ-M Futures and “One-Way Mode” in COIN-M Futures, both their USDⓈ-M and COIN-M Futures will be set to “Hedge Mode” after the upgrade is complete.  Notes: The upgrade will be completed within  approximately 24 hours . The adjustment will  not  impact COIN-M Futures trading operations. Some users might experience intermittent trading disruption during the upgrade period. The issue will be resolved automatically when the users re-attempt the trading operations.   It is recommended that users with  open positions in COIN-M Futures should adjust the position mode setting to align with USDⓈ-M Futures before the upgrade.  During the USDⓈ-M and COIN-M Futures position mode sync up process (only applicable when USDⓈ-M and COIN-M Futures have different position mode settings),  all the open orders in COIN-M Futures,  including reduce-only orders (TP/SL), will be  canceled .  After the position mode sync up process is complete, the  account balance  and  average entry price  of open positions in COIN-M Futures might be  very different from before the upgrade  due to the netting effect of position mode, especially switching from Hedge Mode to One-Way Mode.  From One-Way Mode to Hedge Mode: No change on the average entry price after the adjustment. From Hedge Mode to One-Way Mode:  If long and short open positions exist at the same time, both positions will be closed. A net position will be reinstated in the direction of netting result from both long and short positions at the current mark price. If there is no residual position after netting both long and short positions, no positions will be reinstated. For the users with open positions in  isolated mode , the realised P&L and all margin balance in the Isolated Margin Futures Account will be transferred back to the Cross Margin Futures Account. After the adjustment is complete, new positions will be re-instated in the isolated mode. The margin balance that will be transferred by the system to the Isolated Margin Futures Account is based on the initial margin requirement of the leverage level users have selected before the adjustment.  It is recommended that users with open positions in isolated mode re-assess collateral balance and transfer required margin to the Isolated Margin Futures Account after the adjustment is complete to mitigate against price fluctuations that may occur. Binance is  not  liable for the possible profit or loss could be incurred during the position mode sync up process. There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2026-06-02
